title: iPRA with one explicit computation schema

main.canonical_law: R(0,a;u.h) has the canonical spelling R(0,a;u.0)
main.substitution: capture-free substitution followed by canonical normalization
rules: crossed equation transport at nonliteral-zero source
main.equivalence: Equiconsistent and bi-interpretable with full first-order iPRA
main.proof_status: written mathematical proof with independent review; no new proof-assistant verification

matched_strict.contract: Entire standalone modules, including all public validators, substitution, normalization, scopes, rule logic and JSON interface
matched_strict.control_scope: Matched equivalent crossed/witness-directed scalar presentation, not a literal transcription of Lean MPrf

separate_compact_refinement.calculus: existing guarded scalar calculus; not canonical R
separate_compact_refinement.contract: Compact profiles assume guarded public Eq/D grammar; strict profile validates that grammar and all integer/list certificate syntax

additional_results.name: Pure self-seeded unary obstruction
additional_results.statement: Every unary 0,S,F term has a C such that t(n)<=C or t(n)>=n for every natural n.
additional_results.scope: term definability only; not alone an obstruction to arbitrary graph interpretations

additional_results.name: Zero-equation induction countermodel
additional_results.statement: Zero-equation induction, even with both scalar computations, coverage, separation and successor injectivity, does not recover full equation induction.
additional_results.scope: same scalar domain and actual equality; not a general no-bi-interpretation theorem for all changed domains

additional_results.name: Scalar computation independence
additional_results.statement: Each of the two initialized-iterator computations can fail while the other holds on standard natural numbers with full induction.

limits: No claim that the new R checker is 516 bytes
